summary: Ride A Pet is a Roblox experience about finding eggs around the map, hatching rarer and faster pets, and mutating pets to go faster.

facts.claim: The official experience describes finding eggs, hatching rarer and faster pets, and mutations as the core loop.
WHO'S THAT PET? was live on Roblox after 21:00 CST on 2026-09-26; the official event page lists the Sep 26–Oct 3 window and advertises x2 Cash Boost + More.
Current independent guides consistently identify the Giant Tree, waterfall cave, cliffs, pyramid, and maze as rare-egg search landmarks.
The cross-checked seven rebirth requirements are Horse + $1M, Fox + $50M, Unicorn + $2.5B, Phoenix + $125B, Kitsune + $6.2T, Kitsune + $325T, and Dragon + $50Qa.
The five Weather Mutation multipliers are Shocked 2×, Volted 3×, Rage 4×, Void 10×, and Eternal 100×; the three Hatch Mutation multipliers are Gold 2×, Diamond 3×, and Rainbow 10×.
One Hatch Mutation can coexist with one Weather Mutation; two Weather Mutations do not stack, and a stronger weather trait can replace a weaker one.
